import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())

print("=== Setting up fresh clone ===")

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria/.env /opt/areloria_new/.env")

# Install deps
print("Installing dependencies...")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria_new && pnpm install 2>&1 | tail -20")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Build
print("\nBuilding...")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria_new && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -20")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
